development.developer: Bishan Residential Development Pte Ltd (CapitaLand / Mitsubishi Estate Asia / Shimizu JV)
development.orientation_notes: Two stepped 38-storey towers at 7 Bishan Street 15 linked by three sky bridges. Per-stack facing NOT sourced: public listings mention Bishan-AMK Park / MacRitchie views on some stacks and 'no west sun' on some 3BRs, but no site plan with stack-level orientation was found. Launched Apr-2012 (~$1,600 psf avg), slow sales, relaunched Apr-2014 at 10-15% lower.

launch-peak entry history: realsmart shows 28 of 153 resales (18%) sold at a loss
1,216 sqft 3BR prints at $2,220-2,368 psf on floors 21-35 (2025-26) form a premium tier that dominates the 3BR size cohort and inflates the project median

layouts.notes: single format, deepest print set; $1,926-1,999 psf in 2025-26
rental filings call these 2BR; routinely marketed as 3BR on PropertyGuru (bed_bands: 2BR band to ~1,055 sqft)
3BR/3-bath per listings. 1,216 sqft is a premium tier ($1,957-2,022 in 2024 -> $2,220-2,368 on floors 21-35 in 2025-26). 1,249 sqft prints are all floors 1-10 ($1,802-1,862 2023-24; $2,049 Jun-25).

rare prints, trade below the standard 3BR: 1,259 $1,701 (May-24, fl 11-15); 1,281 $1,702 (Jan-23) and $1,835 (Mar-24), both fl 21-25. A 1,292 sqft 3BR/2-bath listing (Oct-26) has no matching URA area; it may be in this group.
